overview.title: Overview
overview.markdown:
Hospital API admits patients and records visits. A request hits a route, the handler checks configuration, and the visit is stored.

## Where to look

Read **Run it** to start the service. The reference pages list routes and environment variables taken from the source, not from this prose.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Client --> API --> Record
```

guides.title: Run it
guides.markdown:
Install dependencies, export `DATABASE_URL`, and start the process that serves this app.

```bash
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost/hospital
python -m app
```

The site you are reading is static. Mount `static/docs` from the same process.
